summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script that runs `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` is obfuscator.io-style minified (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e` identifiers, per-function string-lookup wrappers) and downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun` releases (v1.3.13) into a temp directory, chmod +x's the extracted `bun` binary, and executes the bundled sibling `math_init.js` under it via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated blob (shuffled `n7gIxM` constants array, `WV8StW` string-array rotation function) whose content is unrelated to the package's stated purpose (a Jest config preset for React Native). This is an alternate-runtime dropper: fetching Bun to execute an opaque payload at install time bypasses Node-oriented scanning and hides the executed code behind two layers of obfuscation. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install` via the `preinstall` lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
